clue.text: Calm in US city after pressure on police

the Criminal Investigation Department of the British police

explanation.walkthrough: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the plain-clothes detective branch of British police forces.

clue.text: Approach at first altered largely over Conservative's cupidity
